effectStyles.name: elevation/overlay
effectStyles.description: Bottom sheets and dialogs only. Lifts them off the scrim.

colors.name: colour/surface/secondary-hover
colors.description: Secondary and ghost buttons on hover.

colors.name: colour/surface/secondary-pressed
colors.description: Secondary and ghost buttons while pressed.

colors.name: colour/surface/inverse-pressed
colors.description: Inverse (ink) button while pressed. Hover uses surface/inverse-hover.

colors.name: colour/surface/overlay
colors.description: Scrim behind bottom sheets and dialogs. Ink at 40%.

colors.name: colour/surface/exchange/clay
colors.description: Exchange tint. Assigned automatically by the system when an exchange is created.

colors.name: colour/surface/exchange/peach
colors.description: Exchange tint. Assigned automatically by the system when an exchange is created.

colors.name: colour/surface/exchange/sand
colors.description: Exchange tint. Assigned automatically by the system when an exchange is created.

colors.name: colour/surface/exchange/mint
colors.description: Exchange tint. Assigned automatically by the system when an exchange is created.

colors.name: colour/border/placeholder
colors.description: Dashed outline for an empty slot, such as a member who has not added a wishlist.

colors.name: colour/border/focus
colors.description: Keyboard focus ring on every interactive element. Disabled uses surface/disabled with text/disabled.

numbers.name: border-radius/rounded-full
numbers.description: No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: icon-size/sm
numbers.description: 16px. Inline icons next to 12 to 14px text.

numbers.name: icon-size/md
numbers.description: 20px. Icons inside buttons, rows and close buttons.

numbers.name: size/avatar-sm
numbers.description: 36px. Small avatars and face stacks on mobile blocks, and the bottom-sheet handle width. No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/touch-target
numbers.description: 44px. Minimum tap target: icon buttons, links, row actions and the profile avatar. No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/control-lg
numbers.description: 56px. Input height, tab bar items and sign-in code boxes. No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/row
numbers.description: 72px. Minimum height of a list row. No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/textarea-min
numbers.description: 96px. Minimum height of a long-text field (textarea). No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/toast-max
numbers.description: 400px. Maximum toast width on desktop. On mobile the toast is full width inside spacing/16 side margins (358px on a 390px screen), so it needs no width token. No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/dialog
numbers.description: 480px. Maximum width of a desktop dialog (modal). Mobile uses the full-width bottom sheet. No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/reading-max
numbers.description: 640px. Maximum width of a single centred reading column on pages without the app shell, such as the public shared wishlist (S25). No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/content-max
numbers.description: 1040px. Maximum width of the main content area on desktop, beside the sidebar. No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/sidebar-min
numbers.description: 240px. Narrowest the desktop sidebar gets. No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: size/sidebar-max
numbers.description: 280px. Widest the desktop sidebar gets. The sidebar flexes between sidebar-min and sidebar-max. No matching primitive; kept as a raw value.

numbers.name: focus/ring-width
numbers.description: Width of the keyboard focus ring.

numbers.name: focus/ring-offset
numbers.description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.
